title: Life Around Us · Q2 W03 D04
objective: Classify familiar examples as living or non-living and describe basic needs or body parts.

items.explanation: An ant grows, eats, drinks, and moves, so it is living. A rock, water, and a pencil do not grow.

items.prompt: Which is NOT a living thing?
items.explanation: A chair does not grow and does not need food or water, so it is not living. The fish, the ant, and the duck are living.

items.prompt: What do all living things need to grow?
items.explanation: Living things need food and water to grow and stay alive. Shelves, batteries, and covers are not food or water.

items.prompt: What do birds use to fly?
items.explanation: Birds fly with wings. Roots, scales, and gills are not wings.

items.prompt: Which example shows a living thing?
items.explanation: A duck grows, needs food and water, and flies with wings, so it is living. A chair, water, and a pencil are not.
